6 things shaping her inner voice that most parents don't even realize. 🦜

Lucy is seven, and the little voice inside her is learning to repeat what it hears:
1️⃣ Constant criticism. ❌
2️⃣ Comparing her. "Why can't you be more like your sister?"
3️⃣ Dismissing her feelings, instead of letting her feel safe with you.
4️⃣ Only noticing mistakes. 9 right, 1 wrong, and we talk about the one. "I only matter when I get it right."
5️⃣ Love that feels earned. "Only if I get an A."
6️⃣ Never letting her fail. "I can't do it."

Twenty years later, Lucy is 27. One typo at work, and the voice in her head says: "Why can't you ever get it right?" 💔

The good news? That voice is learned, which means it can be taught differently. ❤️

"The LORD your God is in your midst… he will rejoice over you with gladness; he will quiet you by his love." Zephaniah 3:17 (ESV) 🙏 His love is given, not earned.

You don't have to be a perfect parent. Just be the voice she repeats: "Your feelings matter." "I'm proud of you." "You're loved, no matter what." ❤️
